en: Vintage monochrome postcard showing a panoramic view of a small alpine town in a valley surrounded by high mountains with some snow on the peaks. The town features a prominent church with a tall bell tower rising above clustered houses and a few larger buildings in the foreground. At the bottom left the caption reads "Pinzolo", and along the lower margin there is a printer/photographer credit line in Italian.
